title: Eternal Bali | Discovering Seashore Temples & Island Wonders
highlights: From Ubud's tranquil rice terraces to Kuta's vibrant beaches, explore Bali, offering a perfect blend of relaxation and excitement.
Walk through the stepped rice fields and see the intricate irrigation system, subak, offering a glimpse into the Bali’s agricultural traditions.
Get up close to over 100 species of fearless creatures like tigers, rhinos, and Komodo dragons at the Bali Safari and Marine Park in Kuta.
Explore the Turtle Conservation Centre, where you can learn about sea turtle preservation efforts and see hatchlings up close in a dedicated sanctuary.
Explore the grounds of Tanah Lot Temple, where you can enjoy the spiritual ambience and Balinese architecture set against a picturesque backdrop.
overview:
About the tour:
Bali is a dream destination for many, and for the good reasons. Whether you crave relaxation on stunning beaches, immersion in spiritual culture, or adventurous activities, Bali offers it all. Visit the charming town of Ubud, nestled in the highlands. From here, explore hidden gems like Kintamani Village, soar on the iconic Bali Swing, and savor the aroma of coffee plantations. Embrace your adventurous side with thrilling water sports at Tanjung Benoa Beach. Explore the iconic Nusa Penida island, home to dramatic cliffs, secluded beaches like Kelingking with its T-Rex rock formation, and Manta Point, a haven for majestic manta rays. Experience the island's cultural heart at the majestic Uluwatu Temple, perched on a cliff overlooking the Indian Ocean. From vibrant coral reefs to cascading waterfalls, majestic temples to rice paddies bathed in golden sunsets, this island paradise promises an unforgettable experience.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Ubud | Leisure Day
days.desc: Upon arriving at Bali's airport, you'll be greeted and transferred to your hotel for check-in. After settling in, you have the option to either relax and unwind or embark on a captivating exploration of Ubud. Discover the enchanting Ubud Monkey Forest, delve into the historical intrigue of Goa Gajah, wander through the serene Ubud Water Palace, or catch a show at Paradiso. After a day of adventure, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, you'll embark on a sightseeing tour of Central Bali, with a convenient transfer from your hotel. Your journey will take you to the stunning Tegenungan Waterfall, the Kintamani Highlands, and Tegallalang Rice Terraces. Take the opportunity to savour the unique Luwak coffee (at an additional cost) and experience the thrill of a ride on the renowned Bali Swing. After a day filled with exploration and adventure, you'll be transferred back to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

days.desc: Today, board your transfer from the hotel for an assisted sightseeing tour of some of Bali's iconic attractions. Capture amazing photos at the Handara Gate with the views of  Mt. Batur. After that, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.desc: Check out from your Ubud hotel and transfer to Kuta, where you'll check in at your new hotel. Later, embark on a pre-booked transfer to the Bali Safari and Marine Park. Enjoy an exciting safari adventure and encounter over 100 wildlife species, including hippos, rhinos, binturongs, Komodo dragons, and tigers. After a day of wildlife exploration, you'll be transferred back to your hotel in Kuta for an overnight stay.

days.title: Excursion to Serangan Island
days.desc: Embark on a thrilling adventure as you get transferred to Tanjung Benoa Beach and board a glass-bottom boat for a scenic ride to Serangan Island. Spot colourful fish and even sea turtles through the clear floor. Soak up the sun and explore the island's charm at your own pace. Head to the Turtle Conservation and Education Center for an informative session. Also, enjoy water sports like jet skiing (at your own cost) at the beach. Later, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.
